blocks.text: Hum Cartesian coordinate system parh chuke hain. Asal mein frame of reference koi bhi aisa coordinate system hai jis ke hisab se naap (measurement) li jati hai. Misal: kamre mein mez ki jagah kamre ki deewaron ke hisab se batai ja sakti hai, to kamra frame of reference hai. Isi tarah laboratory mein li gayi naap ka frame laboratory hai. Yahi experiment (tajurba) chalti train mein karein to train frame of reference ban jati hai. Spaceship ki jagah door ke sitaron ke hisab se batai ja sakti hai; tab un sitaron par based (mabni) coordinate system frame of reference banta hai.
